text:
You're not lazy. You're afraid.

Call it procrastination. Call it being realistic. The truth is simpler: fear freezes you before you start.

Hill studied 500 successes. One pattern killed all excuses. They didn't become fearless. They faced the fear and moved.

Six fears destroy men: poverty, criticism, death, lost love, poor health, uncertainty about tomorrow.

You kill fear one way: by moving toward it. Say the hard thing today. Apply for the job. Ask her. Make the call.

Fear shrinks the moment you refuse to listen to it.
caption:
Most men will fail because of fear before they fail because of ability.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
